content:
Welcome to PaperTape 📼

The best way to use PaperTape is to never title a note, delete a note, or worry about organizing.

Embrace impermanence (and quick scratch ideas).

[←] Swipe or ⌘+[ to see the next note in your deck.

Soulver Math & Percentages

Reactive percentage, currency, and variable math:

subtotal: $150
tip: 20%
subtotal + tip =
30% off $80 =
25 as a % of 100 =

If you change the numbers, all calculated values update instantly!

[←] Next

Dates, Durations & Time Zones

Calculate dates and convert time zones naturally:

today + 30 days
90 days from Oct 1st
9:30 am to 5:45 pm
5pm EST in PST
3pm Tokyo in London

^ Live badge updates in the footer bar automatically!

[←] Next

Interactive Timers

Type "timer 5" for a 5-minute countdown.
Type "timer pomo" for a classic 25-minute Pomodoro timer.
Type "timer" for a live stopwatch.

timer 5
timer pomo

Click the play button on the timer pill to start!

[←] Next

Checklists & Natural Day Reminders

Jot tasks with natural days or times and PaperTape automatically schedules them:

- [ ] Buy groceries tomorrow at 10am
- [ ] Submit quarterly invoice on friday
- [ ] Follow up with design in 2 days

When that day arrives, PaperTape sends a native macOS notification and plays a gentle chime!

[←] Next

The 9 Permanent Slots (⌥1 - ⌥9)

Ephemeral scratches auto-purge after 7 or 30 days so clutter never piles up.

Use the colored dots in the top bar (or ⌥1 to ⌥9) for permanent slots that never expire.

⌘ + N : New note
⌘ + D : Delete note
⌘ + P : Pin / Detach floating window
⌘ + S : Store note permanently in Vault
⌘ + F : Search notes

Start your first scratch note with ⌘ + N!
